integrity: Combinatorial unrestricted-domain proof and a standalone exhaustive finite-domain checker; computational tests are corroboration rather than proof of the unrestricted result.
scientific_limitations: The result identifies a family of intrinsic strict rankings compatible with some unobserved acceptability cutoff, not the actual preference or cutoff. The no-log comparator allows arbitrary presentation orders. The asymptotic record-position/Dickman limit is earlier probability theory, not a claimed novel distribution. External scientific priority has not been independently audited.
title: Exact latent-ranking recovery from sequentially anchored voting ballots
